source_level_cause.mul_mat: IQ4_NL x Q8_0 with identical Q8_0 activation bytes (shown in run 41438394031): native llamafile tinyBLAS_Q0_AVX (8-lane exact-int lanes, FMA per block, AVX hsum) vs WASM ggml_vec_dot_iq4_nl_q8_0_generic (no WASM kernel in arch/wasm/quants.c; scalar per-block sumf += d*sumi). Accumulation order only.
source_level_cause.flash_attn_ext: flash_attn_ext_f16_one_chunk on both (12 rows < 64-row tile; split-KV needs 1 row). Build-dependent parts: Q.K via ggml_vec_dot_f32 (x86 AVX2: 8-wide lanes, FMA; WASM simd128: 4-wide lanes, separate mul+add, different step/reduction), V accumulation via ggml_vec_mad_f32/ggml_vec_scale_f32 (FMA vs mul+add), scalar expf (glibc vs musl). This protocol does not split flash further.

candidate.reason: Two independent op kinds differ on identical inputs in layer0 alone (IQ4_NL mul_mat and flash_attn_ext); the FFN replay showed IQ4_XS mul_mat differs too. A single-op default-off candidate cannot make norm01 bit-identical. The downstream fc2 failure is amplification of any ~1e-7 difference by activation quantization, so a partial fix is not expected to remove it. No full-model candidate measurement was run.
